question.text: The temperature of a gas is $-78^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ and the average translational kinetic energy of its molecules is $\mathrm{K}$. The temperature at which the average translational kinetic energy of the molecules of the same gas becomes $2 \mathrm{~K}$ is :

solution.text:
$\begin{aligned}& \mathrm{K} . \mathrm{E}=\frac{\mathrm{nf}_1 \mathrm{RT}}{2} \\& \mathrm{~T}_{\mathrm{i}}=-78^{\circ} \mathrm{C} \rightarrow 273+\left[-78^{\circ} \mathrm{C}\right]=195 \mathrm{~K}
\end{aligned}$
